description: This PHP source file defines the `OAuthAuthorizationCode` class, which represents an entity for storing OAuth 2.0 authorization code information in a database. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for mapping properties to database columns and includes getter and setter methods for interacting with the entity's data.

classes.name: OAuthAuthorizationCode
classes.description: An entity class representing an OAuth 2.0 authorization code, including properties such as authorization code, client ID, user ID, redirect URI, expiry time, and revoked status, with associated getter and setter methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the authorization code record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the authorization code record.

methods.name: getClientId
methods.description: Returns the client ID associated with the authorization code.

methods.name: setClientId
methods.description: Sets the client ID associated with the authorization code.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns the user ID associated with the authorization code.

methods.name: setUserId
methods.description: Sets the user ID associated with the authorization code.

methods.name: getRedirectUri
methods.description: Returns the redirect URI linked to the authorization code.

methods.name: setRedirectUri
methods.description: Sets the redirect URI linked to the authorization code.

methods.name: getExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Returns the expiry date and time of the authorization code, with timezone set to UTC.

methods.name: setExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Sets the expiry date and time of the authorization code.

methods.name: isRevoked
methods.description: Checks whether the authorization code has been revoked.

methods.name: setRevoked
methods.description: Sets the revoked status of the authorization code.
